thread:
Maya: quick async on enterprise evidence packaging + retention tiers. need clear prioritization so sales can lock pilots.
Tess: a prospect in healthcare is asking for 6 controls: exportable forensics bundle, per-tenant retention policies, SOC2 mapping, and proof-of-handback for BYOK. they want pricing before next Wed.
Diego: technically we can deliver a "forensics bundle" that packages logs + manifests + signatures. biggest unknowns: index size (searchable vs cold) and export performance (they want <6h for a 30GB export).
Hana: security constraints: any export must include tamper-evidence (signed manifest) and an auditable path showing who requested export. also need revocation checks for BYOK keys.
Rafael: compliance asks that we map each exported artifact to SOC2/ISO control IDs. we should produce a control-summary file with links to artifacts. makes audits faster.
Maya: propose three priority lanes: 1) Pilot-ready bundle (V1) - signed manifest, control-summary, and raw blobs. 2) Searchable evidence index (V2) - lets customers query exports quickly. 3) Immutable retention hooks (V3) - policy locks + retention ledger.
Diego: estimated effort: V1 = 2 sprints (ingest/export pipeline + manifest signer). V2 = 3 sprints (indexer + query API + cost analysis). V3 = 4-6 sprints (storage policy + immutable buckets + retention-ledger migration).
Tess: customer will accept V1 if we provide a SLA for export time and documented compensating controls for immutability. they prefer V2 but will pilot V1 if priced and contracted.
Hana: compensating controls we can offer: shorter snapshot cadence (hourly), signed replication logs, and reviewer workflow for export approvals. still no immutability guarantee unless we enable storage locks.
Rafael: for contract language, we need to: 1) define evidence artifacts, 2) outline what we guarantee vs what is advisory, 3) provide an upgrade path to V3 with timelines. I'll draft a template.
Diego: API sketch for docs (include in spec): ```POST /v1/exports {"tenant_id":"t-42","range":{"from":1730000000,"to":1740000000},"format":"forensics-bundle"}``` Response: ```{ "export_id":"exp-789","status":"queued" }``` and later ```GET /v1/exports/exp-789 => {"download_url":"https://...","manifest":"base64sig"}```
Maya: acceptance criteria for pilot: - bundle contains signed_manifest + control_summary - export completes within SLA for datasets <50GB or we provide partial incremental exports - export request audit trail retained >= 2 years - docs + runbook for customer ops
QA Bot: suggested tests: 1) manifest signature verification 2) partial-export resume 3) export requester RBAC enforced 4) control-summary correctness against a seed dataset.
Diego: ops note: export performance largely depends on cold storage throughput and chunking strategy. suggest multipart streaming + pre-signed URLs to avoid double-copy.
Hana: key lifecycle: if BYOK is used, include an export-proof that the data blob was encrypted under the tenant key (key_id in manifest). if customer requires HSM attestation, escalate to enable KMS provider integrations.
Tess: I'll confirm with the healthcare prospect which KMS vendors they'd accept and whether V1 + addendum is okay.
Maya: decision needed: do we push V2 (index) into sprint+1 or do V1 only? recommendation: do V1 in sprint+1 to unblock pilots, start scoping V2 in parallel (spike).
Rafael: agree. V1 helps sales. schedule gating: Product signoff (Maya), Security review (Hana), Compliance checklist (Rafael), Eng capacity OK (Diego), Sales signoff (Tess).
Diego: action items: create spec PR for bundle format + API (due Mon). add load test ticket for 50GB export (due Wed).
Hana: action items: draft security checklist + compensating control wording (due Tue).
Rafael: action items: contract template with control-summary language (due Tue).
Tess: action items: confirm customer acceptance and KMS vendor list (due Fri).
Maya: I'll collate flight-path doc and update roadmap board. reconvene Thurs if customer pushes. :rocket:
Diego: starting PR.
Hana: noted.
Rafael: noted.
Tess: on it.
Maya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
